intro: If you have business around central Nonthaburi or the provincial offices, or simply want a budget-friendly base with easy MRT Purple Line access into the city — Nonthaburi Palace Hotel is a frequent pick for cost-conscious travellers in this area · It's a 3-star hotel of around 150 rooms on Nonthaburi Road in Suan Yai, open since 2008 with some floors renovated in 2024 · Guests consistently praise the spacious, clean rooms and the friendly, helpful staff, plus prices that start very light for the room size · The trade-offs are an older building where unrenovated floors still feel dated, mediocre soundproofing, and a station that's a fair distance away · Rooms start from approx. ฿800/night.

body.html: Nonthaburi Palace Hotel has been a fixture of central Nonthaburi for years, sitting on Nonthaburi Road in Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi, close to the provincial government offices · It opened in 2008, has around 150 rooms, and renovated some floors in 2024 · It positions itself as a budget hotel built around spacious rooms and warm service rather than luxury · Most guests are people with business in Nonthaburi, travellers watching their budget, and those who want to ride the MRT Purple Line into Bangkok without paying for an expensive room.

Rooms come as Superior and Deluxe with either a queen or twin beds · The thing guests mention most is that the rooms are more spacious than expected for the price, with a balcony, refrigerator, work desk and private bathroom · Many reviews call the rooms clean and fresh-smelling, and the cleanliness score sits around 8.8, which is strong for a hotel this cheap · The key thing to know before booking is that this is an older building, and the floors that haven't been renovated feel dated and carry that old-building smell, and several guests agree the soundproofing is weak — you can hear neighbours and the corridor · For the best stay, ask at booking whether you can get a floor renovated in 2024.
"Spacious, clean room and really friendly, helpful staff · Easy to reach the MRT Purple Line into the city, with a 7-Eleven and a night market nearby · Great value for the size of the room."

What pushes this hotel's scores above what the price suggests is the service · The service rating sits around 9.1, which is high, and many reviews praise the reception team as professional, kind and helpful from check-in to check-out · Facilities are what you'd expect from a value hotel: a restaurant, bar, cafe, minimart, lift, free parking, luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk · There are paid airport transfers and taxi booking · The things to understand are that there is no swimming pool or gym like a bigger hotel, and some reviews note that the Wi-Fi signal is weak in certain rooms.

Be clear on the location before you book · The hotel is in the Suan Yai area of Mueang Nonthaburi, near the Chao Phraya River and the Phra Nang Klao Bridge · The nearest MRT Purple Line station is Saphan Phra Nang Klao, about 1.4 km away — walkable but a fair stretch, so most people take a motorbike taxi or ride-hail · From the Purple Line you change to the Blue Line at Tao Poon to reach central Bangkok · Around the hotel there are convenience stores, a night market and local restaurants within walking distance · Don Mueang Airport is about 21 km or roughly 30 minutes by car · The overall score sits around 8.7 from real guest reviews, which is very good for this price bracket.

Honestly, Nonthaburi Palace Hotel is good value if you're cost-conscious, have business around central Nonthaburi, and are fine with an older but well-kept hotel · A spacious, clean room with friendly service from around ฿800 is hard to beat in Mueang Nonthaburi · But if you expect every floor to feel new, good soundproofing and a station you can walk straight to, this may not be your match · And if your goal is sightseeing in central Bangkok or a scenic riverside stay, a riverside boutique in Nonthaburi or a hotel right by the train line will suit you better.

Tips from following the reviews here: at booking, ask whether you can get a floor renovated in 2024 — the refreshed rooms look noticeably newer and nicer · If you're a light sleeper, request a room away from the corridor or the road to avoid noise · If you'll rely on the MRT, plan to take a motorbike taxi or Grab to Saphan Phra Nang Klao station rather than walking · There's free parking if you drive · And always compare prices across Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking, since the starting rate shifts with the season and room type.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Nonthaburi Palace Hotel

faq.q: Where is Nonthaburi Palace Hotel, and how close is the MRT Purple Line?
faq.a: It's at 219 Nonthaburi Road, Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi, near the provincial offices and the Chao Phraya River · The nearest MRT Purple Line station is Saphan Phra Nang Klao, about 1.4 km away — walkable but a fair stretch, so most people take a motorbike taxi or ride-hail · From the Purple Line you change to the Blue Line at Tao Poon for central Bangkok · Don Mueang Airport is about 21 km away.

faq.q: How much does Nonthaburi Palace Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿800/night for a Superior Room · There's a roomier Deluxe Room, plus rooms on a floor renovated in 2024 that look newer · Rooms come with queen or twin beds, a balcony, fridge and work desk · The starting rate shifts with season and room type, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Who is Nonthaburi Palace Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for people with business around central Nonthaburi or the provincial offices, or cost-conscious travellers who want a spacious room near the MRT Purple Line · You get a spacious, clean room with friendly service at a light price · If you expect every floor to feel new, good soundproofing, or want a pool and full facilities, a bigger hotel will suit you better.

faq.q: Is Nonthaburi Palace Hotel old, and are there any renovated rooms?
faq.a: It's an older building, open since 2008, and the floors that haven't been renovated feel dated and carry an old-building smell · However, some floors were renovated in 2024 and look noticeably newer and nicer · Ask at booking whether you can get a renovated floor · One thing many guests agree on is that the soundproofing is weak, so if you're a light sleeper, request a room away from the corridor.

faq.q: What facilities does Nonthaburi Palace Hotel have?
faq.a: There's a restaurant, bar, cafe, minimart, lift, free parking, luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk · Paid airport transfers and taxi booking are available, and Wi-Fi is free (though weak in some rooms) · Note that there is no swimming pool or gym — this hotel focuses on budget-friendly rooms and warm service rather than big-hotel facilities.

faq.q: What is Nonthaburi Palace Hotel's review score, and is it reliable?
faq.a: Nonthaburi Palace Hotel scores around 8.7 from real guest reviews, which is very good for this price bracket · It rates especially well for service (around 9.1) and cleanliness (around 8.8) · Guests praise the spacious, clean rooms, friendly staff and good value · It's a go-to for cost-conscious travellers with business around central Nonthaburi.
